name: Sea thrift
note: Sea thrift, Armeria maritima (docs 10, 14). habitat, growth, flowering, spread and starter work as in reeds.json: thrift wants salty, well-drained shore (the tide band and the first meters inland), never standing water; it is evergreen, so it has no dormant window. spread kind seed: a mature cushion drops a seed every everyH hours distanceM away on one rolled bearing, and it takes only if the ground there scores minSuit. Shape (flora-thrift.wgsl): a cushion is bladesPerCushion fine leaves (more as it grows) from its center out to a low dome of cushionRadius and cushionHeight (smaller while young, from radiusMin), each bladeWidth wide. A seed shows as seedBlades short blades of sproutM. A flowering cushion carries flowersPerCushion pompoms (more as it grows), each on a thin stalk stalkHeight tall (varied by heightVar) with a round head of headRadius, shaded as a ball. season: albedo of the leaves (linear) per season, of the flowers and of the stalks. wind: sway is the stalk's tip bend per unit wind (share of height), gustM and gustSpeed size the passing gusts. look: rootShade at the base, wetDarken in rain, pixelWidth keeps far stalks at least that wide.
